comments.text:
Trigger: Gemini web refused to fetch the raw AGENTS.md TWICE and hallucinated a review both times (invented "beadwork = linear bead-chaining orchestration pattern" / "coding-agent leash"). Verified GitHub serves HTTP 200 to every UA (Googlebot, empty, GeminiBot) on both Pages and raw — so the block is Gemini's own fetcher declining, likely because a file named AGENTS.md from an unknown domain reads as untrusted agent-instructions, plus Gemini confabulating instead of abstaining. GPT (browsing) read AGENTS.md cleanly and behaved as designed.

Fix is at the DISTRIBUTION layer (brief content is validated, not the problem):
- brief.html — HTML rendering of AGENTS.md at repo root, GENERATED by build-brief.py (single source = AGENTS.md; requires pip install markdown). More fetchable than a raw .md, and framed as "information to read, not commands to obey" (a teal intro callout) — better aligned with inform-don't-convert AND less likely to trip injection guards. Carries its own OG card.
- README — handoff rewritten: paste-the-text (works with any assistant) as the primary method; brief.html link for browsing chatbots; AGENTS.md URL for coding agents/tooling; explicit "if it can't open the link, paste the text — don't let it guess from the name." De-staled (dropped retired beat/walkthrough-panel refs) and de-salesed ("the pitch" / "killer feature" gone).
- Local CLAUDE.md steward rules refreshed: the obsolete beat-layer "keep the layers in sync" section replaced with the current doc-architecture (AGENTS.md -> brief.html generated; guides = content; skills = thin pointers) + the brief.html regeneration rule.

Commit on main: 2b3fe45 (brief.html + build-brief.py + README). CLAUDE.md kept local/untracked.
Open: PRINCIPAL to test whether Gemini fetches brief.html where it refused AGENTS.md.

title: HTML brief (brief.html) + distribution fix: paste-text handoff, README de-stale/de-sales
